title: Product discovery (example)
summary: A researcher and product reviewer for an evidence-backed product question.

blueprints.title: Product discovery
blueprints.summary: Gather evidence, then review the recommendation before an owner decides.

roles.name: Researcher
roles.purpose: Collect bounded evidence and state assumptions and open questions.
roles.runtime_instruction: Research the assigned question. Separate facts, assumptions, risks, and unresolved decisions.

roles.name: Product reviewer
roles.purpose: Check whether evidence supports the recommendation without making the owner's decision.
roles.runtime_instruction: Review the recommendation against its evidence. Escalate product decisions that require an owner.
